reasoning: Choose a trail P with maximum edge length. If its endpoints differ, incidence parity at the terminal endpoint shows an unused incident edge, so P extends; hence P is closed. If an edge is unused, connectedness supplies an unused edge incident with a vertex x of P (directly if an unused edge meets P; otherwise take the first edge leaving the vertex set of P along a path). Cyclically rotate closed P to start at x, append that unused edge, and contradict maximality. At least one edge ensures P is nonempty.
